description: Exact outputs of the agent/issuer-side producers. Every key is a fixed Ed25519 seed (`keys`), every nonce/counter/timestamp is fixed, and Ed25519 is deterministic, so a native producer must reproduce `expect` BYTE FOR BYTE (compare parsed JSON). `op` names the producer; `args` its inputs (a name in `signer`/`principal`/`holder`/`to_holder` is a key name from `keys`; `message_utf8` is the UTF-8 text to sign). Domain strings are JSON strings: \u0000 is a NUL byte. `header` is the PCA-Action header value (base64url of the sorted-key JSON of the PCActn). Post-quantum signing is deterministic in the reference too (ML-DSA and SLH-DSA deterministic variants, seeded FN-DSA): those vectors are in producer-pq-vectors.json. An `expect` holding only `error` is a refusal: the producer must throw and sign nothing (parse_limit and compile_policy must also match the message). For facade_act the principal mints the grant with `goal_salt`, the provenance recorder (mediator agent-harness, kid k1, key `recorder_key`, session `session`, clock fixed at `now`) is pinned in the envelope, `principal_messages` are recorded first, and `act` builds a one-node plan `n0` (no nonce unless given; exp = act.now + 20 min); with `sub_agent`, the holder first delegates to that key and the sub-agent acts.
